sources.workshop: In this fictional survey, workshop attendance was associated with higher confidence. Participants chose whether to attend.
sources.tutorial: After an online tutorial, volunteers rated themselves more confident. The study collected no test of practical skill and no observations of performance at work.
sources.stacks: The branch library removed overdue fines in September. Its ledger shows a rise in the number of borrowed books brought back after the change. The library made no record of who returned the books or why.
sources.payments: Several tenants returned their keys late. The housing office recorded higher payments after introducing a late fee. No tenant borrowed money from the office.
sources.transit-a: Route K17: inspectors logged how long passengers waited at stops. The median wait fell from twelve to eight minutes. They did not record how long anyone spent on board.
sources.transit-b: Route K71: inspectors timed journeys between boarding and arrival. Median travel time fell by four minutes. They did not count passengers waiting at stops.
sources.stream:
On the eastern footbridge, a sensor recorded the height of the stream every hour. Readings rose during the storm. Nobody took a water sample or counted fish.

A maintenance crew checked the gauge against a marked staff the following morning. The two instruments agreed to within a centimetre.
sources.water-lab: Technicians tested water samples from the western reservoir before and after a storm. The concentration of suspended sediment increased. They recorded no water levels at the footbridge.
sources.night-count: Observers counted bicycles passing the station entrance in the evening. Counts rose after the lamps were installed. The observers did not interview riders.
sources.night-poll: After the lamps were installed at the station, a questionnaire asked cyclists how safe they felt at night. Most respondents said they felt safer. The questionnaire did not count trips.
